name: Saucy Sausages
description: A flavorful Oktoberfest sausage dish baked in a rich sauce made with chili sauce, salsa, and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: First, boil sausages until almost done or brown them in a frying pan.
In a separate bowl, combine the barbecue sauce, HP sauce, chili sauce, garlic salt, salsa sauce, seasoning salt, ketchup, and onion powder.
Place the sausages in the bottom of a roasting pan or baking dish. Sprinkle with the three spices (garlic salt, seasoning salt, onion powder). Cover with the sauce mixture.
Cover and bake in a 350 °F oven for approximately ½ hour.
Can be served with rice.

keywords: Oktoberfest sausages, saucy sausages, baked sausages

_similar.name: Britt's Favourite Meatballs
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe with a sweet and tangy sauce, baked in the oven.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup quick cook oats or bran

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the first 8 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.
Shape the mixture into 1 inch balls and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink.
Combine sauce ingredients and pour over the meatballs.
Return to the oven for an additional 10 to 15 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, baked, sweet and tangy sauce

_similar.name: Beef Porcupines
_similar.description: Baked meatballs with rice, served in a tangy tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, mustard, chili powder, salt, allspice, brown sugar, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and paprika. Form into balls.
Place meatballs in a baking dish.
Combine tomato soup and hot water to make the sauce. Pour over meatballs.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
_similar.description: Pork chops marinated in a barbecue sauce and baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Trim fat from pork chops and place in a single layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine ketchup, onions, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, mustard, and oregano in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours.
Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender.

_similar.name: Spareribs to Go
_similar.description: A versatile spareribs recipe that can be broiled or heated in a glaze sauce, perfect for make-ahead meals.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil spareribs, cut into serving pieces, in salted water for 1½ hours. Drain and place in a shallow dish.
Pour the glaze mixture (garlic and honey) over the ribs. May be frozen for later use.
To finish, remove ribs from the glaze and broil 6 inches from heat in the oven or barbecue until crisp. Alternatively, baste ribs and heat in the sauce.

_similar.keywords: spareribs, garlic honey glaze, make-ahead ribs

_similar.name: Sticky Wings
_similar.description: Baked chicken wings glazed with a sweet and savory brown sugar and soy sauce mixture.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Break chicken wings apart at the joints and discard tips.
Place wings in a roasting pan and cover with the sauce mixture (brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic salt).
Bake until the sauce evaporates and wings are sticky.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken wings, baked wings, appetizer
